abstract: Published online: 22 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s43246-026-01376-7 Sodium-ion batteries are a low-cost option for grid storage, but graphite anodes limit fast Na⁺ storage. Here, the authors developed a coral-inspired P/S-codoped carbon anode that achieves high-capacity, fast-charging, and durable <mark>sodium</mark> storage through synergistic structural and surface engineering.

abstract: Published online: 22 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02129-z Electrochemical carbon capture promises low-energy direct air capture (DAC), but demonstrations are often confined to small devices and short lifetimes. Here the authors report a 25-cm2 symmetric nickel hydroxide DAC cell operated for 5,000 h at a low energy cost and demonstrate scale-up to a 9 × 300 cm2 stack.
